meanings: for him, for it; for its sake (a new sense of O0396: the conjugated dem in its second sense)
derivation: dem (O0390) 'for, toward, for the sake of' + the 3SG.M ending (orrowen_v2 §3.6: 'the other prepositions follow the same pattern'); O0396 gives only the first sense, 'until him, it', so a reader of the row hears 'made until it' where Halyna say 'made for it'. Merge as a second sense of O0396, not a new entry. Unit W01 (wf12), II.2's reading, line 7: Tevath, galdat demo. Demo hosel.
